newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH GOVMT BODY APPROVES INVESTMENT FUND LAW.
newsitem.headline: POLISH GOVMT BODY APPROVES INVESTMENT FUND LAW.

text.p: The Polish government's economic committee (KERM) approved on Monday a draft law on investment funds, privatisation Minister Wieslaw Kaczmarek said.

He said the draft, which has yet to be approved by the full cabinet, envisages the creation of closed, open-ended and mixed investment funds, which would differ by the method of selling their participation units and investment possiblities.
"The difference is in the way the participation units will be sold and in investment possibilities -- measures aimed at reducing the investment risk," Kaczmarek said.
He added that one of the problems which the full cabinet would have to solve before it approves the draft, was where the funds would be allowed to invest.

"The question is whether the funds would be allowed to invest only in European Union countries or in all countries belonging to the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development," Kaczmarek said.
